question: Find the total number of papers for each affiliation.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "affiliations" AS SELECT "affiliation_id" AS "affiliation_id", "attribute" AS "attribute", "value" AS "value" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "author_paper_affiliation" AS SELECT "paper_id" AS "paper_id", "aid" AS "aid", "aff_id" AS "aff_id" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "papers" AS SELECT "paper_id" AS "paper_id", "title" AS "title", "venue" AS "venue", "year" AS "year" FROM table_5;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH aff_attrs AS (
    SELECT
        affiliation_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(attribute) IN ('name','affiliation','org','organization') THEN value END) AS aff_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(attribute) IN ('address','location','city','country') THEN value END) AS aff_address
    FROM affiliations
    GROUP BY affiliation_id
),
clean_links AS (
    SELECT
        paper_id,
        CAST(aff_id AS BIGINT) AS affiliation_id
    FROM author_paper_affiliation
    WHERE aff_id IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        affiliation_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT paper_id) AS total_papers
    FROM clean_links
    GROUP BY affiliation_id
)
SELECT c.affiliation_id, a.aff_name, a.aff_address, c.total_papers
FROM counts c
LEFT JOIN aff_attrs a USING (affiliation_id)
ORDER BY c.total_papers DESC, c.affiliation_id ASC
